verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document recognizing a previously verified person or reusing a prior passed check across sessions or products. Verification flows reuse only a session *configuration* (docs-8, docs-9), not a user's verified status. Retrieving past results later (docs-16) and blocklisting documents (docs-11) are retrieval and fraud controls, not a reuse or re-verification mechanism. The community mention of "biometric re-log in" (comm-15) is ambiguous and appears to describe a competitor.
